Trace, implement and test: leetcode11 container with most water

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    int maxArea(vector<int>& height) {
        int len = height.size();
        int left = 0;
        int right = len - 1;

        int maxArea = INT_MIN;        
        while(left < right)
        {
            int area = min(height[left], height[right]) * (right - left);
            if(area > maxArea)
                maxArea = area;
            
            if(height[left] <= height[right])
                left++;
            else right--;
        }
        return maxArea;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    vector<int> nums = {1,8,6,2,5,4,8,3,7};
    int res = sol.maxArea(nums);
    cout << res << endl;

    return 0;
}
